title: Instrucciones de Ensamblaje de Muebles Estilo IKEA
prompt:
IKEA style furniture assembly instructions, full page layout, black and white line drawing, minimalist vector style. 1. Top title area: In the center of the top of the paper, clearly write the product name in bold black text: "Simple Round Stool". Next to it, draw a classic cartoon character smiling and giving a thumbs up.
2. Step breakdown (2x2 grid layout):
Top left (Step 1): The screen displays the parts list. It shows 1 round wooden board (seat), 4 identical cylindrical wooden legs, and 6 screws. Next to it, label in Chinese: "Prepare Parts".
Top right (Step 2): The chair seat is flipped upside down. A hand is inserting a wooden leg into a hole in the base. There is a magnifying glass bubble next to it showing details of the screw aligned with the hole.
Bottom left (Step 3): All 4 legs are inserted, and a hand is holding an L-shaped wrench to tighten the last screw. The action has dynamic lines.
Bottom right (Step 4): Assembly complete. The chair is flipped back to the front and stands firmly on the ground. Next to it is a large Chinese text: "Done!".
Overall texture: The paper surface has slight creases, even lighting, sharp and clear text and lines.
Ratio 16:9
